text.div:
Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EHDS Data Category Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 17 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  ehrElectronic Health RecordsElectronic health data originating from electronic health records.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  health-factorsHealth Determinant DataData concerning factors that influence health, including socioeconomic, environmental, and behavioural determinants.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  healthcare-resourcesHealthcare Needs, Resources and Financing DataAggregated data concerning healthcare needs, allocated resources, access to healthcare, healthcare expenditure, and financing.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  pathogen-dataPathogen DataData concerning pathogens that affect human health.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  admin-claimsAdministrative and Claims DataHealth-related administrative data, including claims and reimbursement information.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  human-genomicHuman Genetic, Epigenomic and Genomic DataHuman genetic, epigenomic, and genomic data.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  molecular-omicsHuman Molecular DataHuman molecular data, including proteomic, transcriptomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, and comparable omics data.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  device-generated-personalPerson-Generated Device DataPersonal electronic health data generated automatically through medical devices.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  wellness-appsWellness Application DataElectronic health-related data generated through wellness applications.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  professional-statusHealthcare Professional DataData concerning the professional status, specialization, and institution of healthcare professionals involved in treatment.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  public-health-registryPopulation-Based Health Registry DataData from population-based health registries.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  medical-mortality-registryMedical and Mortality Registry DataData from medical registries and mortality registries.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  clinical-trialClinical Study and Investigation DataData from clinical trials, clinical studies, clinical investigations, and performance studies.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  medical-device-otherOther Medical Device DataOther electronic health data generated through medical devices that are not represented by a more specific category.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  medicinal-device-registryMedicinal Product and Medical Device Registry DataData from registries for medicinal products and medical devices.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  research-cohort-surveyResearch Cohort, Questionnaire and Survey DataData from research cohorts, questionnaires, and health-related surveys.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-data-category-cs  biobankBiobank DataElectronic health data from biobanks and associated databases.

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML

http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  policy-regulatoryPolicy-Making and Regulatory ActivitiesPublic-sector policy-making, planning, supervision, or regulatory activities in the health or care sectors.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  statisticsOfficial StatisticsPreparation and production of official statistics relating to health or care.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  education-teachingEducation or TeachingEducation or teaching activities in the health or care sectors.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  scientific-researchScientific ResearchScientific research related to health or care that contributes to public health or health-technology development.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  development-innovationDevelopment and InnovationDevelopment and innovation activities for products, services, or processes contributing to public health, healthcare, or care.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  algorithm-training-testingTraining, Testing and Evaluation of AlgorithmsTraining, testing, and evaluation of algorithms, including algorithms used in medical devices, in-vitro diagnostic medical devices, AI systems, or digital health applications.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/ehds-secondary-use-purpose-cs  care-improvementImprovement of Care DeliveryActivities aimed at improving healthcare delivery, treatment, or the management of health systems.

Expansion performed internally based on codesystem EU AI Involvement Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 4 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs  ai-generatedAI GeneratedThe substantive content of the resource was generated by an AI system.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs  ai-assistedAI AssistedAn AI system supported a human author, while the human remained responsible for creating the substantive content.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs  ai-reportedAI ReportedAn AI system transformed or reported existing information without independently asserting its clinical validity.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-involvement-cs  ai-assertedAI AssertedAn AI system asserted clinical or factual content as an output of its processing.

text.div:
Expansion performed internally based on codesystem GDPR Article 6 Legal Basis Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 6 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-aConsent (Art. 6(1)(a))The data subject has given consent to the processing of personal data for one or more specific purposes.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-bContract (Art. 6(1)(b))Processing is necessary for the performance of a contract with the data subject or for pre-contractual measures requested by the data subject.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-cLegal Obligation (Art. 6(1)(c))Processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation to which the controller is subject.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-dVital Interests (Art. 6(1)(d))Processing is necessary to protect the vital interests of the data subject or another natural person.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-ePublic Interest or Official Authority (Art. 6(1)(e))Processing is necessary for a task carried out in the public interest or in the exercise of official authority vested in the controller.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art6-codesystem  gdpr-art-6-1-fLegitimate Interests (Art. 6(1)(f))Processing is necessary for legitimate interests pursued by the controller or a third party, subject to the conditions and limitations of Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.

resource.name: GDPRArt6LegalBasisVS
resource.title: GDPR Article 6 Legal Basis Value Set

text.div:
Expansion performed internally based on codesystem GDPR Article 9 Condition Code System v0.1.0 (CodeSystem)

This value set contains 6 concepts

SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-aExplicit Consent (Art. 9(2)(a))The data subject has given explicit consent to the processing for one or more specified purposes, subject to applicable legal limitations.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-cVital Interests (Art. 9(2)(c))Processing is necessary to protect vital interests where the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-gSubstantial Public Interest (Art. 9(2)(g))Processing is necessary for reasons of substantial public interest on the basis of Union or Member State law and subject to appropriate safeguards.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-hHealth or Social Care (Art. 9(2)(h))Processing is necessary for preventive or occupational medicine, medical diagnosis, provision or management of health or social care, or related systems and services, subject to the applicable legal conditions.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-iPublic Health (Art. 9(2)(i))Processing is necessary for reasons of public interest in the area of public health on the basis of Union or Member State law and subject to appropriate safeguards.
http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/gdpr-art9-codesystem  gdpr-art-9-2-jResearch and Statistics (Art. 9(2)(j))Processing is necessary for archiving in the public interest, scientific or historical research, or statistical purposes, subject to Article 89(1) GDPR and an applicable legal basis.
